quizName:
Hardest Questions in Rhode island
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: You miss your turn or exit on a freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Turn quickly from your current lane.
Keep driving until you find the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving until you find the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: If you miss your exit, do not back up. Continue to the next turn or exit where you can safely turn around. Backing up on a freeway shoulder is illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
A traffic light is coming up.

questions.correctAnswerText: A traffic light is coming up.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that there is a traffic light at the intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and be ready to shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for vehicles with disability plates, disabled veteran plates, or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What should you do if you meet an aggressive driver?
questions.explanation: The safest choice is to get out of an aggressive driver's way. Never compete with other drivers on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to watch for bicycles and other traffic that may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means parking is not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if you don't see other traffic.
Signal only if you see other traffic.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if you don't see other traffic.
questions.explanation: Always signal when you turn, change lanes, or pull away from the curb. Make this a habit, not something you do only sometimes.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol harms your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic at a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic at a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, they do not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: Tiredness slows your reactions and dulls your thinking. The safest choice is to stop and rest or let someone else drive.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn. This warns other drivers of your plan.

questions.question: A person's driving ability can be harmed by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires good physical health. Alcohol, drugs, and lack of sleep all make driving unsafe.

questions.question: You are angry after a difficult day at work. When you get to your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you won't think about it.
Drive fast on the interstate to release your anger.
Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
Stop at a bar and have drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, take time to calm down before driving. Driving while emotional is dangerous for you and others on the road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means the action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, they must yield to oncoming traffic and wait until it is safe to complete the turn.

questions.question: Orange diamond-shaped signs are used in construction work zones.
questions.explanation: Most construction zone signs are orange and diamond-shaped. They are reflective so drivers can see them easily at night.

questions.question: Who must wear a seat belt in a moving vehicle?
questions.explanation: All passengers and the driver, regardless of age, must wear a seat belt while the vehicle is moving. Some children may need special safety seats.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you about a steep hill. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is coming. Another road will cross ahead.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers must make 200 decisions for every mile. You must focus on driving. Any other activity can be dangerous and distracting.

questions.question: What should you do if you get drowsy while driving?
questions.explanation: If you feel tired while driving, go to the nearest rest stop or service area. Take a nap, stretch, or let someone else drive. Caffeine pills are not a real solution and can make driving more dangerous.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching railroad tracks?

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate lowers.
Do not worry about how many tracks to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
questions.explanation: When approaching railroad tracks, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop for trains or other vehicles using the tracks.

questions.question: When should you turn off your turn signal?

options.text: In the middle of a turn

questions.explanation: Turn on your signal before you start turning. This tells other drivers what you plan to do. Turn off the signal after you finish the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. This sign warns you that wet pavement is slippery. Drive carefully because it is harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming.
